cases.source:
import GHC
import GHC.Driver.Backend (interpreterBackend)
import GHC.Driver.Session
import Control.Monad.IO.Class
main = do
  writeFile "/tmp/DebugProbe.hs" "module DebugProbe where\nf :: Int -> Int\nf x = x + 1\n"
  runGhc (Just "/tmp/hslib/lib") $ do
    d <- getSessionDynFlags
    _ <- setSessionDynFlags d { backend = interpreterBackend, ghcLink = LinkInMemory, verbosity = 0 }
    target <- guessTarget "/tmp/DebugProbe.hs" Nothing Nothing
    setTargets [target]
    _ <- load LoadAllTargets
    setContext [IIModule (mkModuleName "DebugProbe")]
    r <- execStmt "f 41" execOptions { execSingleStep = SingleStep }
    case r of
      ExecBreak {} -> do
        liftIO $ putStrLn "BREAKPOINT_REACHED"
        r2 <- resumeExec RunToCompletion Nothing
        case r2 of
          ExecComplete {} -> liftIO $ putStrLn "RESUMED_COMPLETE"
          _ -> liftIO $ putStrLn "RESUMED_BREAK"
      ExecComplete {} -> liftIO $ putStrLn "NO_BREAKPOINT"

import GHC.Driver.Backend (interpreterBackend)

main = do
  writeFile "/tmp/DebugProbe.hs" "module DebugProbe where\nf :: Int -> Int\nf x = x + 1\n"
  runGhc (Just "/tmp/hslib/lib") $ do
    d <- getSessionDynFlags
    _ <- setSessionDynFlags $ gopt_set (d { backend = interpreterBackend, ghcLink = LinkInMemory, verbosity = 0 }) Opt_InsertBreakpoints
    target <- guessTarget "/tmp/DebugProbe.hs" Nothing Nothing
    setTargets [target]
    _ <- load LoadAllTargets
    modl <- findModule (mkModuleName "DebugProbe") Nothing
    setContext [IIModule modl]
    r <- execStmt "f 41" execOptions { execSingleStep = SingleStep }
    case r of
      ExecBreak {} -> do
        liftIO $ putStrLn "BREAKPOINT_REACHED"
        r2 <- resumeExec RunToCompletion Nothing
        case r2 of
          ExecComplete {} -> liftIO $ putStrLn "RESUMED_COMPLETE"
          _ -> liftIO $ putStrLn "RESUMED_BREAK"
      ExecComplete {} -> liftIO $ putStrLn "NO_BREAKPOINT"
